identity.description: monday.com is a work-management / project-management SaaS platform (boards, items, columns, automations) with a public GraphQL API at api.monday.com/v2 and a developer center at developer.monday.com.
identity.identity_notes: developer.monday.com and the monday.com docs describe the work OS / boards product named in the task. Confirmed from the API intro and developer center pages.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization code flow. Legacy flow: authorize at https://auth.monday.com/oauth2/authorize, token exchange via POST to https://auth.monday.com/oauth2/token. Legacy flow issues no refresh tokens. A newer OAuth 2.1 flow with expiring access tokens, refresh tokens and revocation is also documented.
auth.token_refresh: Legacy OAuth: no refresh tokens; access tokens do not expire until uninstall. Newer OAuth 2.1: refresh tokens supported. Personal API tokens can be regenerated at any time, which immediately invalidates the old token.
auth.scopes_notes: OAuth scopes are set in the app's OAuth tab in the Developer Center. Personal API tokens carry all permissions that mirror the user's UI permissions; app tokens have a separate scope set.

access.production_restrictions: Developer accounts are for development and testing only. Item, automation, integration and API complexity limits apply. Capacity increase requests go through a marketplace partner extensions form and are reviewed within five business days. Marketplace app review requirements were not established.

read_ops: Querying boards and items (per MCP tool description)
api.rate_limits: Conflicting third-party figures (1,000/day on lower tiers vs 200 calls/day on Free). Official rate-limit figure not confirmed. Official sandbox page lists API complexity limit of 10M and 25,000 actions/month for automations and integrations.
api.limitations: Official docs did not confirm rate limits or the webhook event catalog. Only the GraphQL protocol is documented on the pages fetched; the REST/other-protocol question is unresolved. The 60+ MCP tools count is from the vendor MCP page.
